# Marketing Engineering

> Curated index of products for marketing engineers: marketers who ship code and engineers who do growth, across paid (ads) and organic (SEO, AEO, social, content). Each entry is a product, its URL, a one-sentence description, a category, pricing and how an agent can use it (MCP server, API, CLI, SDK, plugin, web app).

Machine-readable source of truth: catalog.json (JSON, schema in catalog.schema.json). Prefer it over this file when parsing. License: CC0 1.0 (public domain).
